answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in kernel, checked in tundra, and pearl reveals each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 13 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1042 identities would post 4860 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
